collection: While-You-Sleep Storefront launch Canva photo handoff
selection_scope: Approved new Halloween remake photographs only. Old launch graphics, old website look photos, cardigan mock tests and rejected/superseded sprint images are excluded.

sequence_labels: LIFESTYLE: Tommy Kate in a separately composed scene

optimization_policy: Use the existing approved 1024x1536 RGB PNG deliveries. No new optimization or derivative export was performed because the request prohibits image alteration. Canva designer controls final export sizing.
publication_authority: Founder explicitly requested saving selected remake assets in the TDIE GitHub repository. This is a separate asset branch, not a public-site or campaign release.
excluded_categories: Existing launch flyers and September launch photographs
Pink lawyer, Campus Crush and childlike/repeated bed-scene tests rejected in the current review
Sparkle Plans composition-only examples: no complete, quality-verified three-image fashion pack yet
Superseded Pretty Wicked bare basic and same-frame avatar insertion
Retail photographs, mood-board screenshots, avatar reference sheets and account evidence

assets.selection_reason: Strongest hero: recognizable Tommy Kate, inviting doorway activity, rich pink decor and a distinct porch viewpoint. Use as the lead photo; keep the person and threshold visible.
assets.source_version: 7 October 2026 approved Halloween remakes; porch-door revision for Pretty Wicked lifestyle
assets.approval_evidence: claude/WYS_REFERENCE_PACK_2026-10-07.md sections 1 and 9 identify these photographs as approved styling examples. Pretty Wicked lifestyle additionally has the recorded feedback: lifestyle image is much better.
assets.preservation: Byte-identical to both approved pack file and native source. No resizing, compression, repainting, cropping or text changes.
usage_restrictions: AI-generated styling illustration, not an exact retailer product photograph.
Only the five sourced product types belong to the shopping set; furniture, avatar wardrobe, flowers, artwork and other styling props are not included products.
Do not use as proof that unattended sourcing/publication or the customer workflow has passed.
